Remaining: frog, snake, crocodile, turtle. I need a question that splits them as evenly as possible.

"Is it a reptile?" would leave snake, crocodile and turtle, which is a poor split. "Does it walk on four legs?" gives frog, crocodile and turtle against snake, also poor. "Does it mostly eat other animals?" gives snake, crocodile and frog against turtle, again 3 to 1.

"Could an adult fit in your hand?" gives frog (yes) and possibly a small turtle, against snake and crocodile (no). That is ambiguous.

"Is an adult longer than a bus?" would be no for all of them.

"Is an adult heavier than an adult human?" is only crocodile, so 1 to 3.

None gives a perfect 2-2 split. "Does it live in the ocean?" is ambiguous. "Does it have stripes or spots?" is ambiguous too.

Since a perfect split is unavailable, a question that isolates one animal is about as good as a guess. A guess has a 1/4 chance of ending the game at once, so I'll guess crocodile.
